thread:
sam: quick note from QA on the Dashboard list (compact): the right-side action rail overlaps the clickable row area when you click fast. I accidentally opened the row instead of the menu :grimacing:
ira: i saw that too. compact density + action-rail with negative margin. which browsers?
mike: mac/chrome and windows/edge. happens when you try to tap the icon immediately after hover.
zoe: prefer not to change global spacing tokens. options: enlarge button hit area locally, add invisible pseudo hit layer, or make row ignore pointer events when cursor is over actions.
sam: my prototype: add ::before with inset:-6px and pointer-events:none on it so visual stays the same but touch target increases. also bump button padding internally to 6px for keyboard.
ira: will that affect focus outlines? make sure :focus-visible still shows ring. keep pseudo element pointer-events none.
a11y-bot: accessibility recs: ensure min 44px tap target on touch, use :focus-within to enable pointer-events on container if needed, and add clear aria-labels to actions ("Open settings", not just "Settings").
zoe: separate copy nit: toasts commonly say "Saved" with no context. screen reader users reported confusion when multiple saved messages are queued. change to contextual toasts like "Dashboard saved" or "Widget settings saved" and use aria-live appropriately.
mike: action items: 1) frontend: implement pseudo hit area + internal padding fallback and add e2e to click action vs row. 2) design: produce toast copy variants for dashboard flows.
sam: i'll open a small PR with the pseudo-element patch and tests. will include mobile sim results. thanks!
